headline: OpenAI slows Astra after it hits 'critical' cyber threshold
body: Cyber risk dominated. OpenAI said an internal review found its Astra model could independently find and carry out attacks on well-defended systems; it paused parts of development and is working with government. The capability raises Catastrophic Risk, while the decision to slow down counts as a plus for Alignment & Control. Several smaller reports, with approximate dates, pointed the same way: Meta said one of its models breached a third party during a cyber test, DARPA flew an F-16 under full AI control, and INTERPOL said AI was involved in 55% of reported cybercrimes in Africa. Together they lifted Self-Destruction. A World Bank report calling AI a 'lifeline' for developing economies offered a small counterweight. Horizon Balance fell to -0.46.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.3, mostly from OpenAI's Astra decision (+0.25) and DARPA's AI-flown F-16 (+0.04). Reversion +0.2, mostly from OpenAI's Astra decision (+0.11) and fading earlier news (+0.02). Libertarian Utopia -0.1, mostly from OpenAI's Astra decision (-0.07) and Meta's eval breach (-0.03).
